title.zh: ESMA proposes ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins

current_state.zh: ESMA has proposed ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins, tightening enforcement of MiCA rules on stablecoin issuers and service providers operating in the bloc.
